app_changelog: Core Electron update: Performance optimization, custom native player bindings, and automatic fallback improvements.
scraper_changelog: Aggregator Update: Fixed Mp4Upload TLS errors and bypassed ISP Deep Packet Inspection for legacy CDNs.
ui_changelog: UI Update: Added Remove Watch History button ('X' on Continue Watching cards) and improved mirror filtering logic to hide blocked ISP streams.
server_changelog: Server Update: Implemented strict network reachability tests to filter out ISP-blocked video domains. Added REST endpoint for deleting watch history.
